fl-pt-01.front: Six things to agree at the truck?
fl-pt-01.back: Where each goes, back by time, meeting point, who shoots what, signals, what if someone is late (Tip).

fl-pt-04.front: You lose sight of your partner?
fl-pt-04.back: Muzzles up or down, no shooting, call out (75%).

fl-pt-05.front: Is blaze orange required in BC?
fl-pt-05.back: No (95%). Wear it with a partner anyway (Tip).

fl-pt-09.front: Who cancels the licence for a deer?
fl-pt-09.back: The person who killed it, immediately, before handling (99%, item 1).
fl-pt-09.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 236" role="img" aria-label="After a kill: the hunter who killed the animal cancels their own species licence right away, before handling it. You can never use or lend another person licence.">

fl-pt-10.front: Can your brother use his licence on your deer?
fl-pt-10.back: No. Using another person's licence is unlawful (99%, item 2).

fl-pt-12.front: Can you herd deer with an ATV?
fl-pt-12.back: No. No motor vehicle or mechanical device to herd or harass wildlife (99%, item 25).

fl-pt-13.back: Shooter calls it, both watch, both unload, mark two spots, one tracks one watches, walk up together (Tip).
fl-pt-13.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="Both unload. Mark the shot spot and where it was last seen.">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<circle cx="30" cy="32" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="30" y="39" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="56" y="39" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Unload, mark</text>
<path d="M200 200 l-12 -24 a14 14 0 1 1 24 0 z" fill="#e8590c" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="200" y="230" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Shot spot</text><path d="M320 140 l-12 -24 a14 14 0 1 1 24 0 z" fill="#2f3a2b" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="320" y="170" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Last seen</text><text x="90" y="120" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#b3261e" text-anchor="middle">Both unload</text>
<rect x="10" y="262" width="380" height="34" rx="8" fill="#2f3a2b"/><text x="200" y="285.0" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">Unload, then mark two points.</text>
</svg>

fl-pt-14.back: Go to the meeting point and wait the agreed window, then whistle and call (Tip).
fl-pt-14.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 298" role="img" aria-label="Partner missing, in order: one, go to the meeting point and wait the agreed window. Two, three whistle blasts, listen, call and text. Three, go to the truck, plan B. Four, at the agreed time call 911 or send an SOS, and stay where searchers expect you.">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="298" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<text x="200" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Partner did not show up? In order</text>
<rect x="10" y="46" width="380" height="56" rx="10" fill="#dfe6d3" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="42.0" cy="70" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="42.0" y="77" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="80" y="68" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Meeting point</text>
<text x="80" y="90" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">wait the agreed window</text>
<rect x="10" y="108" width="380" height="56" rx="10" fill="#dfe6d3" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="42.0" cy="132" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="42.0" y="139" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="80" y="130" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Three blasts, listen</text>
<text x="80" y="152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">then call and text</text>
<rect x="10" y="170" width="380" height="56" rx="10" fill="#dfe6d3" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="42.0" cy="194" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="42.0" y="201" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="80" y="192" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Go to the truck</text>
<text x="80" y="214" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">plan B</text>
<rect x="10" y="232" width="380" height="56" rx="10" fill="#dfe6d3" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="42.0" cy="256" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="42.0" y="263" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="80" y="254" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Agreed time passed</text>
<text x="80" y="276" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">call 911 or send SOS; stay put</text>
</svg>
